Shaco

Jungle Pure meme

AP Jungle Shaco

How to play this build

Place Jack in the Boxes (W) in the jungle and bushes for control and burst; open with Deceive (Q) from behind and detonate with Gunblade + DFG. The ult clone (Hallucinate) also explodes for AP: pop in, delete two, and vanish.

Skill order

Max priority:

W Caja Sorpresa → E Dos-Cuchillas → Q Engañar

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Jack in the Box (W) for burst and clear (scales with AP); Two-Shiv (E) second for slow/damage. Q at 1 point to reposition.

Items and what they do

  1. Spirit of the Spectral Wraith AP jungle item: power, CDR, spellvamp and strong sustain while clearing.
  2. Hextech Gunblade Hybrid AD/AP with lifesteal and spellvamp; active slows and damages at range.
  3. Deathfire Grasp The classic burst item: AP + active that deals % target-health damage and amplifies your next hit. One-shots.
  4. Rabadon's Deathcap The biggest AP item in the game: multiplies your total AP.
  5. Sorcerer's Shoes Boots with magic penetration.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 gives burst with durability to survive after the assassin combo.
